'''Jihar Cortess''' was a member of [[House Cortess]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Behind the scenes==
If players of the Imperial Agent class choose to spare House Cortess from the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], they will receive a message from Jihar instead of one from [[Vanein Thul]].
